verdict.rationale: Qapita has a dedicated 409A valuations offering that promises independent, audit-ready valuations from qualified experts, so the core service exists. Nothing shows it can be ordered inside the platform, that it is generated from live cap table data, or that valuations refresh on a schedule. Missing for 10: evidence of in-platform ordering, generation from live cap table data, scheduled or recurring refresh valuations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: Independent, audit-ready valuations from qualified experts with no shortcuts and no surprises.
